summary: Adler-32 checksum computation (classic zlib algorithm). a1 carries the rolling 16-bit checksum pair (low word s1, high word s2), a2 is the input byte buffer, a3 is the byte count. Input is processed in chunks of at most 5552 (0x15B0) bytes: each chunk feeds an unrolled 16-byte accumulation loop (s1 += byte; s2 += s1) plus a residual loop for the remaining fewer-than-16 bytes, and both sums are reduced modulo 0xFFF1 (65521) after each chunk. Returns the combined checksum s1 | (s2 << 16). Called by DecompressionStreamRead.

local_names.a1: rolling checksum seed; low word becomes s1, high word becomes s2
local_names.a3: number of input bytes to checksum
local_names.i: remaining byte count for the chunk loop
local_names.v9: number of 16-byte groups in the current chunk

operations.description: Null-input guard: when a2 (the input buffer pointer) is zero, return 1 immediately.
Split the seed: s1 (v4) = low 16 bits of a1, s2 (v5) = high 16 bits of a1; these are the rolling Adler-32 sums.
Chunk loop: while a3 bytes remain, take v8 = min(i, 5552 (0x15B0)) bytes (the NMAX chunk), subtract v8 from i, process the chunk, then reduce s2 modulo 0xFFF1 in the loop's bottom step.
Unrolled 16-byte block: when v8 >= 16, iterate (v8 >> 4) groups, each unrolled as 16 successive accumulations of s1 += byte and s2 += s1.
Residual tail loop: for the remaining v8 (fewer than 16) bytes, accumulate s1 += *v3++ and s2 += s1.
After each chunk, reduce s1 modulo 0xFFF1 (65521).
Return the combined checksum s1 | (s2 << 16); invoked by DecompressionStreamRead.
